decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of refuse or waste have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing of refuse or waste shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. ___________ shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 6 - non standard: The dwelling shall be insulated to achieve a sound level difference when fully furnsihed of 20dB (averaged over the frequency range 100Hz - 3150Hz) in every habitable room exposed to noise from the roundabout/flyover. Every room which is insulated against noise should be fitted with a mechanical ventilation and air-relief system which complies with the specification required by the noise insulation regulations 1975.
Condition : 7 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as [    ].
description: Erection of two storey flank and rear extension and single storey rear extensions to dwellinghouse
